description_en: Queries the binding details of an external identity provider for a specified workspace, including the binding status, application configuration, and callback URLs that need to be configured on the identity provider side. Application secret configurations are not returned
description_zh: 查询指定工作空间的外部身份提供商绑定详情，包括绑定状态、应用配置以及需要在身份提供商侧配置的回调地址。应用密钥类配置不会返回
name: GetIdentityProvider

parameters.help_en: The type of the external identity provider. Valid values: DingTalk, Feishu
parameters.help_zh: 外部身份提供商类型。可选值：DingTalk、Feishu
parameters.name: identity_provider_type
